name: derelict-256
style_block: Top-down 2D game sprite for a drifting derelict starship colony sim. HARD-EDGE FLAT-SHADED game art in the legibility discipline of Prison Architect: every surface is a FLAT FILL, at most THREE value steps per material (shade / body / light), and the steps meet at a HARD EDGE. NO airbrush, NO soft gradient longer than a tenth of the image, NO noise, NO dither, NO grain, NO texture overlay, NO bloom, NO glow haze, NO chromatic aberration, NO vignette. NO fine detail: no hairline seams, no rivets or bolts smaller than a twentieth of the image, no coiled cables, no wire bundles, no panel-line webs, no stitching, no individual hair strands. Fewer, larger, flatter shapes always beat more, smaller, softer ones. Target about twenty flat colours in the whole image. SILHOUETTE: one closed readable mass with at most two subordinate volumes; nothing thinner than a twentieth of the image; the shape must still be nameable shrunk to a thumbnail. OUTLINE: a hard uniform dark ink line about a thirtieth of the image wide around the whole silhouette and around the few major internal divisions — the ink is a very dark desaturated version of the colour it borders, never pure black. LIGHT: one single light source from the UPPER LEFT — every light step on the upper-left of every form, every shade step on the lower-right, no second light, no rim light from below. Camera: orthographic top-down tilted twenty degrees, so a standing object shows a small front face about a fifth of its height; flat floor-level objects are seen straight down. MATERIAL WORLD: a cold, old, welded ship kept alive by repairs — graphite plate, dull steel, dark polymer, one warm aged brass; visible repairs, bolted patches, mismatched panels, weld beads, honest wear. COLOUR IS RARE AND EARNED: surfaces are near-neutral cool grey; the only saturated things are a lit machine screen or indicator (warm amber), a hazard mark (deep red-orange), and living plants (green). NEVER magenta, NEVER neon pink, NEVER electric cyan, NEVER purple. ABSOLUTELY NO DROP SHADOW, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no ambient occlusion pool, no darkened ground under the object — the game draws all shadows itself. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no frame, no border. Object centred, plain flat solid background.

assets.name: anchor_floor
assets.prompt: Seamless repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a flat material sample, not an object, seen straight down with completely uniform light and no lamps and no vignette and no border. MATERIAL: bare graphite deck plating of an old starship. Large square plates roughly two-thirds the width of the image so the joint rhythm is coarser than one tile, separated by a straight recessed channel; one shallow drainage groove crossing the swatch. Exactly three flat values, hard-edged: shade #4e5158, body #6d7077, light #929498. Cool neutral grey, almost no colour at all. WEAR IS THE SIGNATURE: a scuffed traffic lane worn lighter across the plates, one plate replaced with a slightly mismatched welded patch, one dark stain — all drawn using ONLY the three values above, never a new hue and never as noise. No outline, no border, no edge lip, no vignette. Edges must continue the pattern so it tiles perfectly in all four directions.

states.grid: Seamless repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a flat material sample, not an object, seen straight down with completely uniform light and no vignette and no border. MATERIAL: heavy steel walkway grating laid over a dark machine void, the floor of an engineering space. Broad flat bars with wide dark slots between them; the slots are FLAT DARK BARS, never an open lattice you can see through. Exactly three flat values, hard-edged: shade #4e433a, body #695e55, light #867d76 — a warm rusted steel, clearly warmer than a plain grey deck. Wear: a rust bloom at one corner and a bar worn bright by boots, drawn only with those three values. No outline, no border, no vignette. Tiles perfectly in all four directions.
states.seal: Seamless repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a flat material sample, not an object, seen straight down with completely uniform light and no vignette and no border. MATERIAL: poured heat-sealed composite floor of a clean medical bay. Almost white, spotless, with ONE fine straight grout line quartering the swatch. This is the brightest surface on the whole ship. Exactly three flat values, hard-edged: shade #737a7e, body #a1a9ad, light #d9dfe2 — a cold clinical grey-blue white. Wear: one faint scuff near a corner only. No outline, no border, no vignette. Tiles perfectly in all four directions.

states.rime: Seamless repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a flat material sample, not an object, seen straight down with completely uniform light and no vignette and no border. MATERIAL: raw uncoated structural deck of a depressurised compartment — no floor covering at all, bare ribs and stringers showing through, pale frost rime crusted along every seam. assets.name: anchor_wall
assets.prompt: Seamless repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a flat material sample, not an object, seen straight down with completely uniform light and no vignette and no border. MATERIAL: the LIT TOP FACE of a starship hull wall — brushed graphite armour plate seen from directly above. Large plates whose joint rhythm is coarser than the image, a broad straight welded seam, a repaired section bolted flat. This is a bright surface: it is how the ship's architecture reads against its floors. Exactly three flat values, hard-edged: shade #6b7076, body #92979d, light #b9bec3 — cool neutral steel grey with almost no colour. Wear: one long scrape and one darker patched plate, drawn only with those three values. CRITICAL: NO outline anywhere, NO edge line, NO lip, NO bevel, NO border, NO vignette, NO side face and NO vertical face — this swatch is the flat top only. The game draws every edge and corner itself. Edges must continue the pattern so it tiles perfectly in all four directions.

states.side: Seamless HORIZONTALLY repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a flat material sample, not an object, with completely uniform light and no vignette and no border. MATERIAL: the VERTICAL FRONT FACE of a starship hull wall, seen very slightly from above — the face you see below the wall's top. Riveted graphite armour panelling in a horizontal band rhythm, one continuous recessed conduit channel running left to right, one bolted repair plate. This face is in shadow relative to the top: it is clearly darker than the wall top but clearly lighter than a dark floor. At most TWO flat values across the whole height, hard-edged, no vertical gradient — it is a flat face, not a curved cylinder: shade #554d47, body #71665f — a warm dark steel. NO outline, NO edge line, NO top or bottom lip, NO border, NO ground, NO shadow beneath. Left and right edges must continue the pattern for perfect horizontal tiling.

assets.name: anchor_debris
assets.prompt: Seamless repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a flat material sample, not an object, seen straight down with uniform light and no vignette and no border. MATERIAL: collapsed starship wreckage, but composed of only FIVE OR SIX LARGE RECOGNISABLE PIECES across the whole swatch — a torn hull plate, a bent structural strut, a burst crate, a folded deck panel, a snapped beam. Each piece is a flat closed shape with a hard dark ink outline and at most three flat values; the gaps between them are flat dark shadow-free voids. It must NOT be a fine rubble field, NOT a scatter of small fragments, NOT noise. Cool graphite and dull steel with one warm rusted piece; shade #3f434a, body #5c6169, light #868b92, rust #6b5a49. No vignette, no border. Tiles perfectly in all four directions.

assets.name: anchor_door
assets.prompt: CLOSED heavy pressure door set in a wall opening, seen top-down tilted twenty degrees, filling the whole square image edge to edge. A band of hazard marking across the lower third: flat deep red-orange and dark chevrons, four broad chevrons only, hard-edged. One small indicator lamp beside the frame glowing flat warm amber. Three flat values on the slab: shade #4a4e54, body #6a6f76, light #8f949a. Hard uniform dark ink outline around the slab and around the viewport and the hazard band. states.open: The SAME heavy pressure door, OPEN: the slab retracted into the wall so the doorway stands clear, seen top-down tilted twenty degrees, filling the whole square image edge to edge. The open threshold is a flat dark recess crossed by a single raised sill track; the retracted slab shows as a narrow flat band at one side with its hazard chevrons and its handle bar cropped by the wall. The indicator lamp beside the frame is flat warm amber. Same slab values, same ink outline, same hazard colour as the closed version. Flat fills only, no gradient, no glow haze, no shadow, no text.
